load_coco_ref_get_data: load COCO-REF dataset data by splitting pickle files and merging with COCO annotations for a given split
register_coco_ref_datasets: register COCO-REF datasets (refcoco, refcoco+, refcocog) with detectron2 DatasetCatalog for train, val, and debug splits
subsample_coco_ref_data: subsample COCO-REF dataset entries using a fixed random seed for reproducible small-batch evaluation
extract_bbox_segmentation: extract target bounding boxes and segmentations from COCO annotations for referring expression grounding
map_sentences_to_annotations: map referring expression sentences to their corresponding image IDs, captions, and COCO annotation IDs
